One who turns a proverb into action." (Action matters more than words.) 2. **Talmud Bava Metzia 31a:** "One is responsible for preventing harm." (Passive neglect may still carry moral weight.) 3. **Deuteronomy 6:5-7:** "Love the Lord your God... and teach them [your children] diligently."
